name: Lemon Network
description:
🌿 Survival SMP (Chill or Competitive — Your Choice)

Jump into our Survival SMP where you can play your way:

PvP with Consent ✅ — fight only if both players agree

Prefer peace? Lay back, farm, build, and vibe with the community

Cosmetics ✨ to flex your style without changing the survival feel

⚔️ Factions (Everything Goes)

Want no rules and high risk? Our Factions is all-out chaos:

Raiding is allowed 💣

TP Kill / TP Traps are allowed ☠️

Outsmart, outgear, and dominate — trust nobody and protect your base

Whether you’re here to build a cozy town or start a war, there’s a place for you.

Join now and choose your path: Peaceful survival… or total destruction.
